value.zh-CN: 展示与编辑的 JSON 文本，未传时按空文本创建。只有 value 变为与编辑器当前内容不同的值时才会重建编辑器，把 onChange 的值写回 value 不会丢失光标。
value.en-US: JSON text to show and edit; the editor starts empty when omitted. The editor is re-created only when value becomes different from its current content, so writing the onChange value back keeps the caret.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
width.en-US: Width. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

height.zh-CN: 高度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
height.en-US: Height. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

showSearch.en-US: Whether to show the search button.

onChange.zh-CN: 编辑内容变化时触发，参数为编辑器当前文本。
onChange.en-US: Called with the editor's current text when the content changes.

options.zh-CN: 编辑器配置，字段见 JsonViewerOptions。ariaLabel、readOnly、autoWrap 的默认值按键合并，只传部分字段时其余仍取默认值。options 按深比较变化时重建编辑器；就地修改 formatOptions、customRenderRule 等嵌套对象不会被察觉，需替换为新对象。
options.en-US: Editor configuration, fields described by JsonViewerOptions. The defaults of ariaLabel, readOnly and autoWrap are merged per key, so passing some fields keeps the defaults of the rest. A change in options, compared deeply, re-creates the editor; mutating nested objects such as formatOptions or customRenderRule in place is not noticed, so replace them with new objects.

limitSearchButtonBounds.zh-CN: 是否限制搜索按钮的拖动范围在组件容器内。
limitSearchButtonBounds.en-US: Whether to limit the drag range of the search button to the component container.

renderSearchButton.zh-CN: 自定义渲染搜索按钮。第一个参数是创建默认按钮的函数，在插入处调用；第二个参数 `controls` 为搜索状态与方法；`controls.showSearchBar` 是 getter，需在返回的 JSX 内读取。
renderSearchButton.en-US: Custom render for the search button. The first argument creates the default button: call it where the button is inserted. The second is `controls`, holding the search state and methods. `controls.showSearchBar` is a getter and must be read inside the returned JSX.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素，类型为 `JsonViewerElement`，上面挂载着 JsonViewerHandle 的方法。
ref.en-US: The root element, typed `JsonViewerElement`, which carries the JsonViewerHandle methods.

format.zh-CN: 按 formatOptions 格式化当前内容。
format.en-US: Formats the current content with formatOptions.

search.zh-CN: 搜索文本，可选参数控制大小写敏感、全词匹配和正则表达式。
search.en-US: Searches for text; the optional arguments control case sensitivity, whole-word matching and regular expressions.

prevSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到上一个搜索结果，可选步长。
prevSearch.en-US: Moves to the previous search result, with an optional step.

nextSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到下一个搜索结果，可选步长。
nextSearch.en-US: Moves to the next search result, with an optional step.

replace.zh-CN: 替换当前搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除匹配，没有匹配时不做任何事，只读模式下同样不做任何事。
replace.en-US: Replaces the current search match; an empty replacement deletes the match, and nothing happens when there is no match or the viewer is read-only.

replaceAll.zh-CN: 替换所有搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除全部匹配，只读模式下不做任何事。
replaceAll.en-US: Replaces all search matches; an empty replacement deletes them all, and nothing happens when the viewer is read-only.

getStyle.zh-CN: 返回当前的 width 与 height。
getStyle.en-US: Returns the current width and height.
